clue.text: Fine ruler for theory

blocks.note: fine as in slender or narrow

heads is one face of a tossed coin

first and last letters of the word

clue.text: Preferred fruit

clue.text: Toilet seat chucked, did you say?

taken as written

clue.text: Falling over, legs cut

taken as written

clue.text: Storyteller in Sinatra I love to recall

clue.text: Game, no cab?

explanation.walkthrough: Reverse NO CAB to get BACON, another word for which is GAMMON; so the answer is BACK GAMMON, a board game.
explanation.definitionFit: Backgammon is a two-player board game played with dice and counters.

clue.text: Snappy labradoodle, for example

blocks.note: first meaning: irritable, bad-tempered
second meaning: a hybrid of two breeds

clue.text: Eye of giant looking evil, initially

blocks.note: first letters of the four words

first letter of the word

clue.text: Bloke serving turkey with last of sauce

final letter of the word

blocks.note: taken as written

clue.text: Number thirteen I need: four off that?
